messages:
Jordan: Quick sync 00: Acme wants a Hosted API key for a 48h eval. Requirements emailed: IP allowlist, scoped access (generation only), KMS-backed audit logs, and predictable rotation. Who can run the handoff?
Priya: I can handle provisioning. Need: customer contact email, CIDR(s) to allow, and desired TTL (we prefer 24h for security). Also confirm whether they need embeddings.
Jordan: They only need generation for now. Contact is eng+eval@acme.com, CIDR 203.0.113.0/28, ok with 24h TTL if that's our recommendation.
security-bot: Security checklist: POC keys must be scoped, short TTL <= 48h, IP allowlist required, KMS audit=true, console UI disabled. Anomaly alert thresholds default to 3x baseline.
Priya: I'll create a scoped key named poc_acme_gen with 24h TTL and the CIDR. Sample internal request:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.io/v1/admin/keys \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"customer":"acme","scope":"generation","ip_allowlist":["203.0.113.0/28"],"ttl_seconds":86400}'
```
Response (redacted):
```json
{
  "id": "k_2026_acme_09",
  "secret": "sk_live_XXXX",
  "expires_at": 2461916400
}
```
Remi: Recommend we set soft quota 5k tokens/day and rate limit 10rps for the POC. If they need more throughput we should propose a Dedicated pool.
Jordan: Pricing: offer $3k credit for the two-week POC. If they convert, discuss reserved capacity.
Priya: ops-bot triggered create-flow. Will post secret to #secure-handoff and add AE to the Handoff thread.
ops-bot: Key created: k_2026_acme_09 (expires 2461916400). Secret posted to #secure-handoff. Audit logging enabled (KMS).
QA: Test plan: AE should validate token by making a simple generation call and return model_status. Example:
```
curl https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \
 -d '{"model":"gpt-4-lite","prompt":"Status?","max_tokens":5}'
```
Priya: Rotation plan: daily rotate script will call internal rotate endpoint and revoke old immediately after new secret is confirmed. Sample rotate call:
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.io/v1/admin/keys/rotate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \n  -d '{"key_id":"k_2026_acme_09","revoke_old":true}'
```
Priya: I'll also create a short README in the secure-handoff message with: how to call, allowed models, TTL, rotation cadence, how to request extension.
security-bot: Note: for enterprise signal, enable retention 180d for audit events. POC can default to 90d but signal if customer requests longer.
Jordan: We'll go 90d retention for now; record in the deal notes.
Nina: After handoff, ask customer to confirm a successful generation call in the next hour. If failure, ping infra-oncall.
Jordan: Thanks all. Priya 1: can you confirm when posted and close this thread?
Priya: Posted to #secure-handoff and DM'd AE. Closing after customer confirms. :white_check_mark:
